summary:
This is the **title page**. It states the full title — *Deep Learning with Python, Third Edition* — the authors **François Chollet** and **Matthew Watson**, and the publisher **Manning**, located in **Shelter Island** (New York). (The bundle groups this page under the "Praise for the Second Edition" span of PDF pages 3-6, but it is really the title page.)

Together with the copyright page that follows (p.6: © 2026 Manning Publications Co., ISBN 9781633436589), this gives everything you need to cite the book, e.g.:

> Chollet, F., & Watson, M. (2026). *Deep Learning with Python* (3rd ed.). Manning Publications.

(Citation format is an illustration, not from the book.)

**How to use this page:** there is nothing to study; continue to the brief contents (p.7) for the book's structure.
takeaways: Full title: Deep Learning with Python, Third Edition; authors François Chollet and Matthew Watson; publisher Manning, Shelter Island.
